message:
No, I can't keep your Tuesday and Thursday mornings completely free without breaking one of your other constraints. I haven't changed Plan A. It's still the unsaved draft from before: CRNs 91010, 91020, 91030 and 91040, for 13 credits.

CS3650 is required and has three sections:
- Section 01 (91010) meets Tue/Thu 9:50–11:30 AM, so it breaks your morning preference.
- Section 03, Honors (91012) meets Tue/Thu 12:00–1:40 PM, which fits. It has a MATH2800 prerequisite, though, and your profile doesn't show that course as completed. I can't register you for it as things stand.
- Section 02 (91011) meets Tue/Thu 2:00–3:40 PM, which fits. It requires lab section 02 (91021), which meets Wednesday 12:00–1:10 PM. Your Wednesday work shift starts at 1:00 PM, so the two overlap by 10 minutes.
- The other labs: Section 02 only pairs with lab 91021, so I can't swap in the Friday lab to avoid the overlap.

You can have free Tuesday/Thursday mornings only if you change something outside the catalog:
1. Adjust your Wednesday shift. If you could start at 1:10 PM or later, or the overlap is workable (for example, you leave the lab 10 minutes early), I'd switch Plan A to 91011 + 91021 + 91030 + 91040. I'd check it before presenting it. I treated your work hours as fixed, so I haven't built that plan as feasible.
2. Take Honors section 03. This would need MATH2800 completed or a prerequisite waiver. I can't arrange that with my tools.
3. Keep section 01. This is the current Plan A, with CS3650 on Tuesday/Thursday 9:50–11:30 AM.
4. Postpone CS3650 and its lab. This would clear your mornings, but it delays a required course. It also would leave you short of your 12-credit minimum unless we add other courses.

Which option do you want? If you choose option 1, I'll draft the revised Plan A and show you the exact changes. I won't save or register anything until you tell me to.
